name: Quoref: A Reading Comprehension Dataset with Coreferential Reasoning
description: Quoref is an extractive reading comprehension benchmark consisting of 24,354 questions over 4,705 Wikipedia paragraphs. Specifically curated so that resolving coreferential ambiguities across character names and pronouns is essential to identify the correct answer span.
